title: Nov 2026 General Membership Luncheon
seo_title: Nov 2026 General Membership Luncheon | Springfield, MI
description: The Republic Area Chamber of Commerce is hosting its November 2026 General Membership Luncheon on November 3, 2026, from 11:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. at Convoy of Hope, 1 Convoy Drive, Springfield, MI. The event is listed under business networking and community. Admission is $15 at the door for those who miss online registration.
price: $15 at the door for those who miss online registration
